title: A hadba lépés tragédiája (Entry into War & Bombing of Kassa (1941))
grammar: Causal Triggers, Tragedy Descriptors & Historical Memorial Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how Hungary entered the war after the bombing of Kassa in 1941.
I can say what a hatására, következtében or ürügyén clause shows about a cause.
I can say how Hungary entered the war in June 1941.
I can use six words about Hungary's entry into the war, such as hadüzenet and hadjárat.
